question: District Project Management Units (DPMUs) initiative launched under PM Vishwakarma scheme in July 2025 comes under which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **District Project Management Units (DPMUs)** initiative under the **PM Vishwakarma Scheme** was launched in July 2025 to empower artisans and craftsmen across India.
 
• This scheme is implemented by the **Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)**, which is responsible for promoting, developing, and enhancing the skills of small and medium-scale entrepreneurs in India.
 
• The **PM Vishwakarma Scheme** aims to support traditional artisans and craftsmen such as carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, and cobblers, among others, to enhance their productivity and improve their livelihoods.
 
• Under this initiative, **DPMUs** act as implementation units at the district level, ensuring effective delivery of scheme benefits, including skill training, financial support, and market linkages for artisans.
 
• The Ministry of MSME plays a crucial role in achieving the objectives of this scheme by coordinating with state governments and local bodies to address the challenges faced by artisans and small-scale entrepreneurs.
